rationale: A known, held process-setting step and the measured baseline-to-settled turnaround difference support an estimate of that change's effect at the tested operating point. The mapping bounds this estimate to the tested conditions, addresses disturbances, and requires comparable repetition for causal attribution.
signal_basis: - Steady-state change: the net difference between the baseline level and the settled level of queue, waiting time, throughput and end-to-end turnaround.
